title: {{subscribe_tool}} — input
description: Input schema for the SOX subscribe operation. Registers the calling agent's interest in channels matching a pattern. The subscription is persisted in the backing store and survives MCP server restarts. Idempotent: registering the same (agent_id, pattern) pair twice produces no duplicate subscription and no error. Normative reference: CONTRACTS.md §5.3 and spec/ports/backing-store.md §2.3.

pattern.description: Channel name pattern. Two forms are supported: (1) Exact match — the pattern equals the full channel name (e.g. 'ticket:ENGI-0042'). (2) Glob — the pattern contains one or more '*' wildcards matched against the full channel name string using Unix glob rules (e.g. 'ticket:ENGI-*' matches 'ticket:ENGI-0001' and 'ticket:ENGI-9999' but not 'project:ENGI-0001'). The '*' wildcard matches any sequence of characters including the empty string. Pattern matching is case-sensitive. Glob patterns containing '*' that match the reserved prefixes 'dm/' or 'group/' are rejected — these namespaces require explicit channel names or group lifecycle verbs. Exact-match subscriptions to 'dm/<sorted-pair>' or 'group/<group-id>' are permitted for current members. See docs/decisions/dm-semantics.md and docs/decisions/groups-model.md.

anyOf.description: Wildcard subscriptions on the dm/ prefix are forbidden. Use an exact dm/<sorted-pair> channel name instead.
Wildcard subscriptions on the group/ prefix are forbidden. Use an exact group/<group-id> channel name or a group lifecycle verb instead.
